notes: Input: prev/next are lists of snapshot rows. Cost values are decimal strings (compare numerically).
Expected: 'kinds' is the ordered list of Diff.kind and is the primary assertion for every case. 'diffs' (oracle/corrected cases) are full Diff objects.
Compare diffs on kind, catalog_sku, cost_before, cost_after, spec_before, spec_after. 'notes' is informational free text; do not assert on it except that cost diffs carry a magnitude.
Output order: sorted by upstream_sku, then emission order within a SKU (cost diff, then spec_increase, then spec_decrease, then plan_renamed).
Spec change is only inspected when prev.spec_hash != next.spec_hash. Numeric dimensions: cpu_count, ram_gb, storage_primary_gb, port_speed_mbps.
plan_renamed is emitted only when product_name changed and no numeric dimension moved.
Mechanical cases give only kinds; the other origins carry full diffs.

Cases with origin 'corrected' REPLACE archived behaviour: a port must implement the corrected rule (H6: any non-numeric / null / type-changed numeric spec field is a parser_error, storage type downgrade is a spec_decrease; H10: empty next snapshot is a single scrape_failed with null catalog_sku, not mass plan_retired).
The archived classification of os_image_removed as SAFE is not part of the differ.
Corrected storage-type ranking (NVMe > SSD > HDD) is the minimum needed for these vectors; the full ordering is a port decision to confirm.
properties: pure (inputs not mutated; repeated calls give identical output)
order-independent (permuting prev/next row order yields the same set of (catalog_sku, kind) pairs)

diffs.notes: next snapshot empty while previous had 2 rows; treat as failed scrape, not mass retirement
